changelog:
✨ New Features
• Add "Show in-app notification for patch updates" setting
• Navigation bar: Add "Glass navigation bar" setting
• Third-party lyrics: ttml, ruby, romanization enhancement

🌟 Mod Features
• All Morphe patches for YouTube Music
• Customizable preset settings
• Extra clone variant with Dynamic Island on supported devices
• In-app update check for new builds

🐛 Bug Fixes
• Spoof video streams: Playback freezes if the server sends a SABR error instead of a stream range
• Resolve lyrics panel, button, and translation language/locale failures
